title: Structure Seedance shorts like a character trailer to build audience attachment…
content:
Structure Seedance shorts like a character trailer to build audience attachment first: World → Hero → Personality → Conflict → Power → Hook.

For stronger character engagement in Seedance, prompt calm, confident expressions and powers that reflect the character’s personality before escalating to action.

Maintain character consistency by explicitly repeating “Maintain identical [character], wardrobe, props, companion, environment, lighting, weather intensity and animation style” across all shots in your Seedance prompt.

Use a shot-by-shot Seedance prompt with exact timestamps, shot types (extreme close-up/wide/overhead), and camera moves (whip pan, rapid push-in, orbital tracking, steadicam tracking, side-dolly, Dutch-angle macro, 360 top-down rotation, boom-up) to control pacing and cinematography.

Lock the visual style by specifying a consistent look stack in the prompt (high-end stylized cinematic 3D animated feature film, semi-realistic proportions, painterly PBR materials, sophisticated graphic lighting, atmospheric depth, premium cloth/hair/creature simulation).

Keep audio coherent by prompting continuous VO + ambience + SFX + orchestral score and calling out seamless continuity across shots (rain/forest ambience/creature calls/weapon impacts).

es.content:
Estructura los shorts de Seedance como un tráiler de personaje para construir primero la conexión con la audiencia: Mundo → Héroe → Personalidad → Conflicto → Poder → Gancho.

Para lograr una mayor conexión con el personaje en Seedance, pide expresiones calmadas y seguras, y poderes que reflejen la personalidad del personaje antes de escalar hacia la acción.

Mantén la consistencia del personaje repitiendo explícitamente “Maintain identical [character], wardrobe, props, companion, environment, lighting, weather intensity and animation style” en todos los planos de tu prompt de Seedance.

Usa un prompt de Seedance plano por plano con marcas de tiempo exactas, tipos de plano (extreme close-up/wide/overhead) y movimientos de cámara (whip pan, rapid push-in, orbital tracking, steadicam tracking, side-dolly, Dutch-angle macro, 360 top-down rotation, boom-up) para controlar el ritmo y la cinematografía.

Bloquea el estilo visual especificando en el prompt una pila de look consistente (high-end stylized cinematic 3D animated feature film, semi-realistic proportions, painterly PBR materials, sophisticated graphic lighting, atmospheric depth, premium cloth/hair/creature simulation).

Mantén el audio coherente pidiendo VO + ambience + SFX + orchestral score continuos y señalando continuidad perfecta entre planos (rain/forest ambience/creature calls/weapon impacts).

High-end stylized cinematic 3D animated feature film. Semi-realistic proportions, expressive sculpted faces, painterly PBR materials, sophisticated graphic lighting, atmospheric forest depth, premium cloth and hair simulation, fast kinetic action pacing.

Environment: Ancient rain-soaked forest sanctuary at night, gigantic twisted trees, moss-covered stone ruins, hanging vines, drifting mist, glowing insects, wet stone reflecting warm amber lantern light.

Audio: Continuous calm, dryly confident male Voiceover (VO), nighttime rain, forest ambience, creature calls, weapon impacts, cinematic orchestral soundtrack.

[Visual & Narrative Execution]

Shot 1 — 0:00–0:01.5

Extreme close-up de los dedos de [Image_1] rozando lentamente tres pequeños amuletos tallados con bestias que cuelgan de su cinturón. Uno de los amuletos brilla brevemente en ámbar.

VO: "They say beasts can't be reasoned with..."

Camera: Low-angle macro tracking across the charms toward his hand.

Sound: Wooden charm clicks, faint animal growl underneath the rain.

Shot 2 — 0:01.5–0:03

Wide shot de [Image_1] de pie solo bajo un árbol ancestral enorme mientras la lluvia cae a través del dosel. Su pequeño compañero, parecido a un zorro con plumas, se sienta con calma sobre su hombro.

Camera: Whip pan down from the gigantic tree canopy to [Image_1].

Sound: Wind rushing through leaves, distant thunder.

Shot 3 — 0:03–0:04.3

Extreme close-up del rostro de [Image_1]. Sus ojos ámbar miran de reojo mientras se forma una pequeña sonrisa cómplice.

VO: "Hunters call me reckless."

Camera: Rapid push-in toward his eyes.

Sound: Low thunder rumble.

Shot 4 — 0:04.3–0:05.8

Mid shot en el que tres cazadores de bestias blindados caen de repente desde unas ruinas de piedra elevadas y lo rodean, con las armas desenvainadas.

Shot 5 — 0:05.8–0:07.5

VO: "I prefer... appropriately optimistic."

Camera: Steadicam tracking backward directly in front of him.

Shot 6 — 0:07.5–0:08.5

Shot 8 — 0:09.7–0:11

Medium shot.

[Image_1] se detiene y gira ligeramente hacia cámara mientras los cazadores se reposicionan detrás de él.

On-screen Dialogue: "Bad throw."

Camera: Quick lock-on focal pull to his amused face.

Sound: Crisp dialogue over fading chain rattle.

Shot 9 — 0:11–0:13.5

High-speed wide shot.

[Image_1] lanza un silbido agudo con dos dedos.

De inmediato, un enorme ciervo espectral irrumpe entre la niebla a su lado y carga a través del patio, obligando a los cazadores a dispersarse.

Camera: Fast side-dolly tracking parallel to the charging beast.

Sound: Piercing whistle followed by thunderous hooves and explosive orchestral surge.

Shot 10 — 0:13.5–0:15

Close-up de la mano de [Image_1] girando con calma su bastón tallado de madera una vez antes de sujetarlo.

Camera: Dutch-angle macro tracking around his hand and staff.

Sound: Sharp wooden rotation followed by a deep resonant click.

END FRAME:
[Image_1] levanta la mirada hacia los atacantes restantes mientras la música cinematográfica asciende.

Sound: Heavy splash and snapping vines.

Shot 15 — 0:21.2–0:22.5

Low-angle tracking close-up.

[Image_1] cruza con calma el arroyo usando el lomo expuesto de una gigantesca bestia fluvial acorazada que emerge bajo el agua como un escalón en movimiento.

Camera: Close tracking on his boot landing as the creature surfaces.

Sound: Deep water displacement, gentle ripple.

Shot 16 — 0:22.5–0:24

Mid shot.

[Image_1] golpea una vez con la punta de su bastón contra la piedra mojada.

Las huellas animales luminosas desaparecen al instante.

Camera: Chest-level medium shot.

Sound: Deep wooden tap followed by sudden silence.

Shot 17 — 0:24–0:25.5

Wide shot.

Los dos cazadores restantes se quedan inmóviles.

Detrás de ellos, enormes bestias guardianas sombrías emergen en silencio entre los árboles.

Los cazadores dejan caer lentamente sus armas al mismo tiempo exacto.

Shot 18 — 0:25.5–0:27

Close-up.

[Image_1] extiende la mano con naturalidad y rasca bajo la barbilla a la pequeña criatura emplumada. Esta cierra los ojos felizmente.

ja.content:
Seedanceのショートは、まず視聴者の感情移入を高めるために、キャラクター・トレーラーのように構成する：World → Hero → Personality → Conflict → Power → Hook。

Seedanceでキャラクターへの没入感を強めるには、アクションに入る前に、そのキャラクターの性格を反映した落ち着きのある自信に満ちた表情や能力をプロンプトで指定する。

Seedanceのプロンプト全体で、各ショットにわたって「Maintain identical [character], wardrobe, props, companion, environment, lighting, weather intensity and animation style」を明示的に繰り返し、キャラクターの一貫性を保つ。

Seedanceのプロンプトでは、正確なタイムスタンプ、ショットタイプ（extreme close-up/wide/overhead）、カメラ移動（whip pan, rapid push-in, orbital tracking, steadicam tracking, side-dolly, Dutch-angle macro, 360 top-down rotation, boom-up）を含むショットごとの構成にして、テンポと撮影表現をコントロールする。

プロンプト内で一貫したルックスタック（high-end stylized cinematic 3D animated feature film, semi-realistic proportions, painterly PBR materials, sophisticated graphic lighting, atmospheric depth, premium cloth/hair/creature simulation）を指定し、ビジュアルスタイルを固定する。

音声は、連続するVO + ambience + SFX + orchestral score を指定し、各ショット間でのシームレスな連続性（rain/forest ambience/creature calls/weapon impacts）を明示して、整合性を保つ。

Seedance 프롬프트의 모든 샷에 걸쳐 “Maintain identical [character], wardrobe, props, companion, environment, lighting, weather intensity and animation style”를 명시적으로 반복해 캐릭터 일관성을 유지하세요.

연속적인 VO + ambience + SFX + orchestral score를 프롬프트하고, 샷 간 매끄러운 연속성(rain/forest ambience/creature calls/weapon impacts)을 명시해 오디오의 일관성을 유지하세요.

Estruture os shorts de Seedance como um trailer de personagem para criar vínculo com o público primeiro: Mundo → Herói → Personalidade → Conflito → Poder → Gancho.

Para um engajamento mais forte com o personagem em Seedance, peça expressões calmas e confiantes, além de poderes que reflitam a personalidade do personagem antes de escalar para a ação.

Mantenha a consistência do personagem repetindo explicitamente “Maintain identical [character], wardrobe, props, companion, environment, lighting, weather intensity and animation style” em todos os planos do seu prompt de Seedance.

Use um prompt de Seedance plano a plano com timestamps exatos, tipos de plano (extreme close-up/wide/overhead) e movimentos de câmera (whip pan, rapid push-in, orbital tracking, steadicam tracking, side-dolly, Dutch-angle macro, 360 top-down rotation, boom-up) para controlar o ritmo e a cinematografia.

Trave o estilo visual especificando uma stack de aparência consistente no prompt (high-end stylized cinematic 3D animated feature film, semi-realistic proportions, painterly PBR materials, sophisticated graphic lighting, atmospheric depth, premium cloth/hair/creature simulation).

Mantenha o áudio coeso pedindo VO + ambience + SFX + orchestral score contínuos e destacando continuidade perfeita entre os planos (rain/forest ambience/creature calls/weapon impacts).
